source_locator: Official 2019 annual report; municipality-wide activity and finance sections reviewed.
evidence_note: The reviewed annual report did not document a major tourism or accommodation intervention matching the November 2017 anchor, while the hotel-capacity series remains almost unchanged across the adjacent windows.
review_limits: One municipal annual report and the registered hotel-capacity series cannot establish the absence of an unobserved private or regional shock.

source_locator: Official 2021 accounts, p. 31: tourism projects 2019-2023, first project stage completed, with 2020-2021 investment-account amounts.
evidence_note: Vitznau began a tourism-project programme in 2019, late in the post-treatment window. The official retrospective describes concrete tourism measures and village-centre visual improvements, but the hotel-capacity series is stable across the full adjacent windows.
review_limits: The source gives a programme period and later expenditure, not the exact monthly activation or overnight-stay effect of each measure.

source_locator: Operator history timeline: 2019 hotel opening with 64 rooms, seminar and conference facilities, fitness centre and lounge.
evidence_note: The 64-room FOCUS Hotel opened in 2019, and the official hotel-capacity series records its largest year-on-year bed jump in June 2019. This directly changes the outcome-generating accommodation capacity during the post window.
review_limits: The source establishes the opening year and scale but not a monthly causal effect on total municipal overnight stays.

source_locator: Official 2019 annual report, financial-statement p. 15 (PDF p. 92): tourism expenditure CHF 88,920 versus CHF 86,500 budget; variance attributed to printing.
evidence_note: The reviewed report shows only a small tourism-budget overrun attributed to printing the municipal publication. The hotel-capacity series declines gradually rather than displaying a large abrupt break.
review_limits: The annual report cannot rule out private investment or visitor-market spillovers outside the municipality.

source_locator: Official regional-tourism listing: seven rooms; historic hotel and all room bathrooms renovated in 2018.
evidence_note: The seven-room Hotel Loewen was renovated in 2018. This is a direct accommodation change, but it is small relative to the municipal hotel stock and the mean available-bed series remains effectively unchanged across the adjacent windows.
review_limits: The listing does not provide the renovation month, closure duration, occupancy response or evidence about other local projects.

source_locator: Official cantonal release dated 2 November 2017: conditional CHF 2 million contribution to a CHF 10.1 million Heididorf expansion.
evidence_note: One day after the analytical treatment anchor, the canton announced a conditional CHF 2 million contribution to a CHF 10.1 million Heididorf expansion. The official release calls the site system-relevant tourism infrastructure and states that the project should strengthen the regional tourism system.
review_limits: The announcement establishes commitment and intended tourism relevance, not the construction calendar, operating date or realised overnight-stay effect.

source_locator: Contemporaneous 17 June 2017 report documents the previous-evening opening and seven hotel rooms; current operator document independently confirms seven rooms.
evidence_note: Hotel Barracuda opened about four and a half months before the November 2017 anchor with seven rooms. This plausibly explains part of the increase in open establishments, but the bed stock rises by only about five percent between the adjacent-window means.
review_limits: The opening is close to the anchor, so the 36-month pre-period is not structurally homogeneous even though the hotel is small.
